## flow-status

Governs: `src/main/flow/** src/renderer/flow/**`

- {**F1** Where a change's the workspaces spec has no `## Verification criteria` heading, Atril shall show the stage Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts proposal}
- {**F2** Where it has `## Verification criteria` and no `## Approach`, Atril shall show Spec. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts criteria}
- {**F3** Where it has `## Approach` and its checklist holds no box, Atril shall show Plan. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts approach}
- {**F4** Where its checklist holds at least one open box, Atril shall show Construir with closed / total and the first open box. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts open}
- {**F5** Where every box is closed and the change folder still exists, Atril shall show Terminado sin aterrizar. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts all}
- {**F6** Where the workspace has `.agents/`, no change folder, and commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Aterrizado. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F7** The checklist reader shall ignore boxes inside a code fence, and in the workspaces spec boxes outside `## Checklist`. src/main/flow/checklist.test.ts fenced}
- {**F8** When a change's files change on disk, Atril shall update the stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts file}
- {**F9** If a workspace has no `.agents/` directory, then Atril shall show "sin Libretto". src/main/flow/stage.test.ts no}
- {**F10** Where the workspace has `.agents/` but no change folder and no commits ahead of its base commit, Atril shall show Entrada. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts fresh}
- {**F11** When `.agents/` appears in a workspace that showed "sin Libretto", Atril shall show its stage within one second. src/main/flow/watch.test.ts agents}
- {**F12** Where several change folders exist, Atril shall show the most recently modified one and list the others. src/main/flow/stage.test.ts several}

## settings

Governs: `src/main/credentials/** src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**S1** When a token is saved, Atril shall store it encrypted with `safeStorage` in `~/.atril/secrets.bin`, and the file shall not contain the token in clear. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts saved}
- {**S2** If `safeStorage` encryption is unavailable, then Atril shall refuse to save and say why. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts refuses}
- {**S3** No IPC response, log line or file other than `secrets.bin` shall ever contain a saved token. src/main/credentials/store.test.ts token}
- {**S4** When the Jira token is saved, Atril shall check it with `/rest/api/3/myself` and show the account name, or the service's error without the token. src/main/credentials/check.test.ts check}
- {**S5** While a token is stored, the Ajustes card shall show "Guardado" with the account and offer only Reemplazar and Borrar, never the token. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts saved}
- {**S6** If a feature needs a service with no token, it shall show "Conecta <servicio> en Ajustes" with a link to that card. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts missing}
- {**S7** When the person presses «Crear token en Atlassian», Atril shall open Atlassian's API token page in the default browser and nothing else. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts create}
- {**S8** While a Jira token is saved, the top bar shall show the account's avatar and display name from `/rest/api/3/myself`; the avatar is fetched by the main process and reaches the renderer as image data only, never with the token; clicking the chip opens Ajustes. src/renderer/settings/settings.test.ts top}

## work-inbox

Governs: `src/main/jira/** src/renderer/inbox/**`

- {**I1** When the inbox refreshes, Atril shall call `GET /rest/api/3/search/jql` once with the JQL in Constraints. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts queries}
- {**I2** When the API returns issues, Atril shall list each issue's key, summary, type and status. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts parses}
- {**I3** If no Jira token is saved, or the API rejects it, then the inbox shall show "Conecta Jira en Ajustes" with a link, and shall never ask for the token anywhere but Ajustes. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts inbox}
- {**I4** When the person starts a task whose project and component have no remembered repo, Atril shall ask for one and remember it for the next task of that project and component. src/main/jira/start.test.ts remembers}
- {**I5** When the dialog opens, Atril shall propose the issue key exactly as Jira gives it (`WEB-3535`) as the branch name. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I6** When Start is confirmed, Atril shall launch `claude` with the bundled Libretto plugin, its hooks and the prompt `/libretto:libretto-flow <KEY>` in the new workspace's agent session — the plugin-namespaced name observed in box 4, because the bare `/libretto-flow` exists only where Libretto is installed globally. src/main/jira/start.test.ts start}
- {**I7** If an issue key does not match `^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]+-[0-9]+$`, then Atril shall refuse to start it. src/main/jira/start.test.ts refuses}
- {**I8** If the In Progress transition fails, then Atril shall keep the workspace and agent running and show the error. src/main/jira/start.test.ts transition}
- {**I9** While a workspace record carries a task's key, the inbox shall show that workspace instead of Start, also after a restart. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts task}
- {**I10** If the proposed branch already exists in the repo, or its worktree path exists, then the dialog shall say so and propose the key with the first free letter suffix: `B`, `C`, `D`… (`WEB-3535B`), as the team does. src/main/jira/start.test.ts proposes}
- {**I11** When the inbox shows tasks, Atril shall group them: status category `new` → Por empezar; `indeterminate` whose status name says in progress → En curso; any other `indeterminate` → En revisión y despliegue, folded by default. src/main/jira/inbox.test.ts groups}
- {**I12** While the Trabajo screen is shown, the sidebar shall show the running work first and the Jira tasks only as a one-line summary of counts that opens the Tareas screen. src/renderer/inbox/inbox.test.ts sidebar}

## workspaces

Governs: `src/main/** src/preload/** src/renderer/** resources/** !src/main/jira/** !src/renderer/inbox/** !src/main/flow/** !src/renderer/flow/** !src/main/credentials/** !src/renderer/settings/**`

- {**W1** When a repo is registered and none of the three signals is found, Atril shall set its mode to `worktree`. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W2** If the checkout holds a git-ignored file outside dependency, build and editor noise (`node_modules`, `vendor`, `dist`, `build`, `.cache`, `.next`, `coverage`, `tmp`, `.idea`, `.vscode`, `.DS_Store`, `*.log`), then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and name that file as the reason. Only files count — entries of `git ls-files --others --ignored --exclude-standard --directory` that do not end in `/`; ignored folders (build output, tool caches) are never a signal. Noise names match at any depth. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W3** If every `node_modules` and `vendor` directory, at any depth, together exceed 2 GB, then Atril shall set the mode to `in-place` and say so. src/main/repos.test.ts chooses}
- {**W4** Where the person has set a repo's mode, Atril shall use it instead of detection, across restarts. src/main/repos.test.ts person}
- {**W5** When a workspace opens in `worktree` mode, Atril shall run `git worktree add` at `~/.atril/wt/<repo>/<branch>` on a new branch. src/main/workspaces.test.ts creates}
- {**W6** If a branch name fails `git check-ref-format --branch`, then Atril shall refuse before running any other command. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W7** While an `in-place` repo has an open workspace, Atril shall refuse to open a second one in that repo. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W8** If the main checkout has uncommitted changes, then opening an `in-place` workspace shall refuse and change nothing. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W9** When an `in-place` workspace is closed, Atril shall check out the previous branch from its workspace record; if the branch has uncommitted changes, it shall refuse instead. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W10** If a worktree has uncommitted changes, then Atril shall refuse to remove it and say to commit or discard first; a clean worktree is removed with `git worktree remove` (never a recursive delete) and its agent session ended. src/main/workspaces.test.ts refuses}
- {**W11** When a workspace opens, Atril shall write its workspace record and start its agent in a tmux session named `atril-<workspace id>` with `remain-on-exit on`, recording the agent's pane id. src/main/tmux.test.ts starts}
- {**W12** When Atril starts, it shall show every workspace record, attach to its tmux session when one exists, and start no new agent; a record whose session is gone shows `stopped`. src/main/tmux.test.ts reattaches}
- {**W13** When the person splits a pane, Atril shall add a tmux pane to that session. src/main/tmux.test.ts split}
- {**W14** When a Claude hook reports a `Notification` event for a session, Atril shall set its agent state to `needs-you`. src/main/status.test.ts claude}
- {**W15** When a session enters `needs-you`, Atril shall show one macOS notification, and no other until the session leaves that state. src/main/status.test.ts notifies}
- {**W16** If the agent's pane (by its recorded pane id) is dead or missing, Atril shall set the agent state to `stopped`; other panes of the session do not count. src/main/status.test.ts exited}
- {**W17** When the usage endpoint answers, Atril shall show the Claude 5 h and 7 d percentages and reset times it returns. src/main/usage.test.ts parses}
- {**W18** The OAuth token shall never appear in Atril's log, in any IPC message to the renderer, or in any file under `~/.atril/`; the runner shall not log the stdout of a command marked secret. src/main/usage.test.ts token}
- {**W20** If a usage source cannot be read, then Atril shall show "—" with the reason. src/main/usage.test.ts missing}
- {**W21** If git, tmux, claude or jira is missing or fails its version command — `-V` for tmux, `version` for jira, `--version` for the rest — then Atril shall name it with its install command — git `xcode-select --install`, tmux `brew install tmux`, claude `curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash`, jira `brew install ankitpokhrel/jira-cli/jira-cli` — and keep the rest of the app working. src/main/doctor.test.ts names}
- {**W22** The sidebar, panes and every button shall be reachable by keyboard — `⌘L` moves focus from the terminal to the sidebar and `⌘J` to the right panel, as menu accelerators the terminal never receives — and every state colour shall carry a text label. src/renderer/a11y.test.ts states}
- {**W23** When Atril launches for the first time, it shall run the tutorial, highlighting each element in turn with its explanation. src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts first}
- {**W24** When the person skips or finishes the tutorial, Atril shall not run it again on launch, and shall reopen it from Help → Tutorial. src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts tutorial}
- {**W25** While the tutorial runs, it shall be operable by keyboard alone (next, back, skip). src/renderer/tutorial.test.ts tutorial}
- {**W28** When the person clicks a sidebar section's title, Atril shall fold or unfold that section, keep its count visible, and remember the state across restarts. src/renderer/sidebar.test.ts section}
- {**W29** When Atril starts a Claude agent, it shall pass `--plugin-dir` with the Libretto copy bundled in the app, so the flow works on a machine where Libretto was never installed. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W30** The bundled Libretto shall carry its `LICENSE`, `THIRD-PARTY.md` and every licence file under `licenses/`, and the version it was copied from. src/main/libretto-bundle.test.ts bundle}
- {**W31** When Atril starts a Claude agent in a workspace it created, the agent shall not stop at Claude Code's folder-trust prompt. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W32** While one or more tools have problems, the top bar shall show a single chip with their count, and the full list with install commands only when the chip is opened. src/renderer/doctor.test.ts problems}
- {**W33** When Atril starts a Claude agent, the agent shall load the person's own user and project skills, commands, agents and plugins as well as the bundled Libretto: Atril adds `--plugin-dir` and never passes `--setting-sources`, `--bare` or anything else that drops them. src/main/agent.test.ts claude}
- {**W34** Where the person picks a model in Start or in "Nuevo trabajo", Atril shall launch Claude with `--model <alias>` (`opus`, `sonnet`, `haiku`; no flag for "Por defecto"), store it in the workspace record, and show it on the workspace row. Fable is not offered. src/main/agent.test.ts chosen}
- {**W35** Atril shall offer three themes in Ajustes — Claro, Oscuro and Automático (default, follows macOS); the choice persists across restarts, Automático switches live when the system appearance changes, and every theme keeps text contrast at 4.5:1 or more. src/renderer/theme.test.ts theme}
- {**W36** If the main checkout of an in-place workspace is no longer on that workspace's branch when it is closed, then Atril shall refuse, say which branch it is on, and move nothing. src/main/workspaces.test.ts in-place}
- {**W37** If reading usage fails (429, network) after a successful read, then Atril shall keep showing the last good values marked with their age, and double the wait before the next try (up to 10 min); the first success returns to every 60 s. src/main/usage.test.ts rate}
- {**W38** When the person clicks a needs-you notification, Atril shall show the Trabajo screen with that workspace selected, whatever screen was open. src/renderer/a11y.test.ts notification}
- {**W26** When a Claude hook reports `Stop` for a session, Atril shall set its agent state to `needs-you`; when it reports `UserPromptSubmit`, to `working`. src/main/status.test.ts stop}
- {**W27** When a session leaves `needs-you` and enters it again, Atril shall notify again. src/main/status.test.ts re-entering}
